tools.name: guild_envelope_issue

offline-verifiable.

No key, payment or network trust is required. A valid result means exact
integrity, Guild provenance and authenticated sender at issuance — not
that the committed message is true or that its recipient accepted it.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: guild_preflight_deep, guild_watch, guild_watch_feed · Private data: guild_paid_operations, guild_register, guild_prove, guild_prove_verify, guild_record, guild_passport, guild_verify, ag_capabilities, ag_json_canonicalize, ag_data_dedupe, ag_data_record_link · Public sink: guild_paid_operations · Destructive: guild_preflight.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: guild_preflight_deep, guild_watch, guild_watch_feed · Private data: guild_paid_operations, guild_register, guild_prove, guild_prove_verify, guild_record, guild_passport, guild_verify, ag_capabilities, ag_json_canonicalize, ag_data_dedupe, ag_data_record_link · Public sink: guild_paid_operations · Destructive: guild_preflight

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
